full_prompt_en: A square monochrome drawing study shows an older man's face in close profile, turned toward the right. The furrowed brow, heavy eyelid, prominent nose, compressed lips, and stubbled jaw are observed with severe attention. A hand holding a pencil enters from the lower right, its tip near the mouth, making the process of drawing visible within the image. The man's head fills nearly the whole frame, while pale paper remains open behind the right side of the face. Soft graphite shading models the cheek and forehead; dense charcoal-black passages gather in hair, ear, neck, and deep facial creases. Fine directional hatching follows the skin's planes, and faint construction marks remain around the lower edge. Light comes broadly from the upper right, catching the ridge of the nose and wrinkled eye area while the left side sinks into dark. The close crop and visible hand make the scene intimate and investigative rather than formal. Smudges, erased highlights, and paper tooth give the drawing a physical working surface. The whole frame feels like an exacting studio study, where patient observation and the pressure of the pencil matter more than polished completion.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形单色绘画习作以近距离侧面呈现一位年长男子的面孔，他朝右转。皱起的眉、沉重眼皮、突出的鼻子、紧闭嘴唇和带胡茬的下颌得到严谨观察。一只握铅笔的手从右下进入，笔尖靠近嘴边，使作画过程本身出现在画内。男子头部几乎填满画框，面孔右侧仍留有开放的浅色纸面。柔和石墨调子塑造脸颊与额头；密实炭黑聚在头发、耳朵、脖颈和深刻面部皱纹中。纤细顺形排线沿皮肤色面走向，底边还留着淡淡结构线。光从右上方宽阔落下，照亮鼻梁和眼周皱纹，左侧沉入暗部。近裁切与可见的手使场景亲密而带研究性，而非正式肖像。擦抹、橡皮提亮和纸面齿纹赋予作品真实的工作表面。整幅画像一张严谨的工作室习作，耐心观察与笔尖压力重于抛光完成度。
style_prompt_en: A close graphite-and-charcoal drawing style builds volume through directional hatching, rubbed middle tones, dense black pockets, and erased light. A tightly cropped focal surface occupies most of the frame, with open pale paper balancing one side. Fine line follows planes and wrinkles while broader smudges connect them. Visible construction marks, paper tooth, and a few unfinished edges preserve the working-study character. Broad side light makes selected ridges and textures legible without smoothing them. A drawing tool or other small process detail may enter the frame and give the image immediacy. The mood is patient, searching, and tactile, with observation evident in every mark.
style_prompt_zh: 近景石墨与木炭素描风格通过顺形排线、擦开的中间调、密实黑色凹处和橡皮提亮建立体积。紧密裁切的焦点表面占据大部分画框，一侧开放浅色纸面形成平衡。细线沿平面和皱纹运行，较宽擦痕把它们连起。可见结构线、纸面齿纹和若干未完成边缘保留工作习作性质。宽阔侧光使精选棱线与肌理清楚，而不抹平。画笔或其他细小创作过程物件可进入画框，增加现场感。气氛耐心、探寻、可触，每一笔都显出观察。
theme_en: A close graphite study of a weathered man's face with a drawing hand visible
theme_zh: 一幅近距离石墨人物习作，刻画饱经风霜的男子面孔并露出作画的手
name: Conte drawing
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
